mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias and orthostatic hypotension; fluphenazine causes orthostatic hypotension and QT prolongation, compounding cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, blood pressure, and ECG; ensure adequate potassium supplementation; counsel patient on orthostatic precautions and position changes.
